exposure: mode of delivery (caesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
type of caesarean section (elective vs. emergency)
finding: Both elective and emergency caesarean sections are associated with increased risks of early and persistent wheezing up to school age.
mod_finding: While both elective and emergency caesarean section were associated with increased risk of wheezing, only elective caesarean section was associated with higher FeNO levels.
